fx: Builds a basic campfire that allows cooking and the placement of up to 3 additional camp features. Players sitting or crafting nearby for 1 min will gain benefits from other camp features.
Builds a journeyman campfire that allows cooking and the placement of up to 5 additional camp features. Players sitting or crafting nearby for 1 min will gain benefits from other camp features.
Builds an expert campfire that allows cooking and the placement of up to 10 additional camp features. Players sitting or crafting nearby for 1 min will gain benefits from other camp features.

Constructs a mana well that allows you and others sitting nearby to regenerate 10 (below level 24), 15 (levels 24–33), 20 (levels 34–43), 24 (levels 44–53) or 29 (level 54+) Mana every 5 sec, muutally exclusive with Blessing of Wisdom.

Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour.

Constructs a sharpening wheel that grants you and others sitting nearby 6 (below level 24), 11 (levels 24–37), 20 (levels 38–51) or 34 (level 52+) increased Strength, mutually exclusive with Strength of Earth Totem.

Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour.

Summons an enchanted lute that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain 163 Armor, 7 increase to all stats, and 6 increase to all resistances, mutually exclusive with Mark of the Wild.

Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour.
(Numbers at level 30; they grow with your level.)
summary: Increased Armor, all stats and resistances

fx: Summons a Reagent Bot that allows you and others nearby to purchase reagents. Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour.

Unpacks a first aid kit that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain 3 (below level 12), 8 (levels 12–23), 21 (levels 24–35), 34 (levels 36–47), 45 (levels 48–59) or 56 (level 60+) increased Stamina, mutually exclusive with Power Word: Fortitude.

Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour.

Places a small fish bowl that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain 8% increased stats, mutually exclusive with Blessing of Kings.

Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour.

Ignites an incense candle that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain 2 (below level 14), 6 (levels 14–27), 12 (levels 28–41), 18 (levels 42–55) or 25 (level 56+) increased Intellect, mutually exclusive with Arcane Intellect.

Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour.

Builds a tent that allows you and others sitting nearby to increase Rested experience to 5% of a level. No effect if Rested experience already exceeds that value.

Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour.
summary: Rested XP up to 5% of a level

fx:
Erects a lodestone that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain 12 (below level 12), 20 (levels 12–21), 32 (levels 22–31), 49 (levels 32–41), 67 (levels 42–51) or 90 (level 52+) increased melee Attack Power, mutually exclusive with Blessing of Might.

Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour.

Assembles a camp chair that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain 2% increased critical strike chance with all spells and attacks, mutually exclusive with Moonkin Aura.

Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour.

Unrolls a banner that allows you and other members of the Horde sitting nearby to gain 14 (below level 40), 19 (levels 40–49), 27 (levels 50–59) or 32 (level 60+) increased Spirit, mutually exclusive with Divine Spirit.

Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour.

Places a fermenter that allows the creation of certain reagents, and provides all of the benefits of a Mana Well. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over a Mana Well to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour.

Places an anvil, and provides all of the benefits of a Sharpening Wheel. Requires a Campfire nearby. 

May be placed over a Sharpening Wheel to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour.
Lay out Cookie's Feast that contains Stamina-boosting food. Requires a Cooking Fire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour.

Places an Arcane Salvager that enables more efficient disenchanting, and provides all the benefits of an Enchanted Lute. Requires a Campfire nearby. 

May be placed over an Enchanted Lute to replace it.
 All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour.
summary: Increased Armor, all stats and resistances
